response.sql:
WITH eligible_patients AS (
    SELECT l.ID
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
    GROUP BY l.ID
    HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN l.`U-PRO` = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
), per_patient AS (
    SELECT l.ID,
           AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt,
           AVG(1.0 * l.ALP / NULLIF(l.GPT, 0)) AS avg_alp_gpt_ratio
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
    JOIN eligible_patients AS e ON e.ID = l.ID
    GROUP BY l.ID
)
SELECT CASE WHEN p.SEX IS NULL OR TRIM(p.SEX) = '' THEN '' ELSE p.SEX END AS SEX,
       AVG(pp.avg_pt) AS avg_patient_pt,
       AVG(pp.avg_alp_gpt_ratio) AS avg_patient_alp_gpt_ratio
FROM per_patient AS pp
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = pp.ID
GROUP BY CASE WHEN p.SEX IS NULL OR TRIM(p.SEX) = '' THEN '' ELSE p.SEX END;

assumptions.assumption: A missing or blank SEX is represented as the empty-string group; zero GPT makes that record's ALP/GPT ratio undefined and excluded from that patient's ratio average.
